factor_name: Inverted downside-risk-adjusted medium-term trend with short-term confirmation

calculation.description: Ranks assets inversely by 60-day return divided by 60-day downside volatility, with a 25% multiplier confirming the 10-day direction. The negative sign converts the empirically persistent trend relationship into a forward-return forecast direction. Higher values indicate stronger expected 10-trading-day returns in the validated sample.

validation.regime_notes: IC/ICIR: 2020-24 0.009681/0.027013 (142 dates); 2025-26 0.058421/0.184661 (137); 2027-28 0.078675/0.265236 (479); recent one year 0.113169/0.376040 (262). At least 8 instruments were required per daily cross-sectional observation.
